cases.name: Gloria B. Hardy
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Gloria loved to go out to eat with friends Sis Imes and Sonja Arentz and enjoyed square dancing, listening to Conrad Fisher and attending Raggamuffin Hall, attending the McCoysville Presbyterian Church, and spending time with her family, especially her precious great grandsons, Waylon and Kavik.
She retired after thirty-three years of employment at Empire Kosher Poultry and was a member of the Millerstown Moose Lodge #925 and the Crawford-Brubaker VFW Post 5863 of Mifflintown, and a former member of the McCoysville Presbyterian Church."
